//: `npm run build` runs node build.mjs, which writes dist/ — not the public/ Vercel looks for by default. That mismatch is the whole reason a build can succeed and still fail to deploy.
//headers: Mirrors serve.mjs PROD=1 exactly. Immutable for the responsive image rungs and the fonts is safe BECAUSE those filenames are content-addressed by width — bake-responsive.mjs regenerates them wholesale and a changed image gets a changed name. Do not extend immutable to anything hand-named. Vercel applies every matching rule and the LAST match wins per header key, so the specific paths come after the general one.
//cleanUrls: Deliberately OFF. Every internal link on this site is written as an explicit menu.html / about.html / contact.html, in the ending block that is copied byte-for-byte across four pages. cleanUrls would send all of them through a 308 redirect.
